title: Documentation: ReadStream should document expected behaviours
body:
### Version

5.0.0

### Context

ReadStream does not document:

- The expected startup behaviour.  
To my mind a ReadStream has to start paused and should not send any data through until either resume or fetch is called.  
Otherwise it's not possible to configure handlers correctly using the facilities provided by the interface.
- The behaviour when fetch is called with an  unacceptable (negative) value.  
Some implementation throw IllegalArgumentException (DatagramSocketImpl), some accept it and reduce demand (TimeoutStreamImpl) others ignore it (HttpServerImpl).  
I tend to consider InboundBuffer as the definitive implementation, so I think that the exception is the expected behaviour.

Happy to provide a PR with updated JavaDocs.
